description: Reorder, duplicate, rotate, or insert blank pages in a PDF client and server side from freedailypro

pageSpecs.description: Ordered list describing the output PDF's pages -- 'source' with a 0-based index (and optional rotation) to reuse a page from the input, or 'blank' to insert a blank page

index.description: For a "source" entry: the index of the page in the source PDF.

rotation.description: For a "source" entry: the rotation to apply to the page, in degrees.

type.description: The kind of page to place here: "source" (a page from the PDF) or "blank" (a blank page).
